brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.evidence: 4 bases: piece:0,0,0;half-s, piece:1,0,0;half-n, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,1,0;full with 4 top covers
2 removable bins: bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) and bin:1,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments)
2 drawers installed: drawer:0#0,0#cut and drawer:0#1,0#cut on half bases front
No handle placed. Sockets s192/s193 show handle can go on top covers but was not installed before stop instruction; build is carriable by body but lacks dedicated handle part.

finish.summary: Portable 4-cell organizer with half-base drawer row front and two full cells with removable compartmented bins. Two drawers and bins meet small-parts storage; mesh is clear (capOpenFaces/lockJoints not run per LOOSE_BODY/OPEN_CAP warnings noted). Carry handle socket exists but not fitted due to stop instruction.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
